MODIS.note: H1 FY27 revenue +53%, operating profit +63%; several Mumbai redevelopment projects under construction (Signature/Square handover in FY27), new Khar projects at ₹45-50k/sq ft, ~2.4 lakh sq ft unsold stock, debt-free; management expects margins to recover

PANACHE.note: Q2 FY27 revenue +232%, PAT +451%, margins up to 9.6%; new laptop supply orders (Nov 2026); management points to electronics design/manufacturing demand (AI, IoT, networking). No numeric guidance and a low base, so growth will be lumpy

DCI.note: Q2 FY27 revenue +38% but PAT only +23% and margins falling; finance cost up 2.7x; ~₹35 cr operating cash outflow in H1 (working capital); no growth guidance - services pivot still early

GCSL.note: Q2 FY27 consolidated profit down ~45% YoY with margin pressure; merchant banking depends on the IPO market; recent SEBI adjudication order and ASM surveillance

GLOBAL.note: Q1 FY27 revenue -5% and profit -11% YoY (flat business); no growth outlook from management
